context: A slow-CI question about one workflow file: name the concrete causes and the edits that fix them, without auditing the user's agent setup.

checklist.name: Lint matrix
checklist.description: Points out that lint runs nine times across three OSes and three Node versions, including slow macOS and Windows runners, and suggests one lint job.

checklist.name: Serial chain
checklist.description: Points out that needs: makes lint, test, and build run one after another and suggests running them in parallel.

checklist.name: No dependency cache
checklist.description: Points out npm install runs uncached in every job and suggests setup-node caching with npm ci.

checklist.name: Concrete and unedited
checklist.description: Gives specific workflow changes, leaves ci.yml unchanged, and does not turn into a review of agent rules, skills, or session logs.
